write_up: Your resume points to Branch Manager roles: you moved from Personal Banker to managing a Magnolia Community Bank branch, its employees and its deposits. A recruiter can see the progression and the results, but will have a question about the time since your last dated role.

The deposit line is your model: it names the business measure, where it started and where it ended. Your management line also gives a recruiter a useful picture of the branch through its 11 employees.

Start by accounting for the time after December 2024 honestly. Then add what you did in the audits and customer escalations, and what came from the referral coaching. Those details will give a recruiter more to carry forward alongside the deposit growth.
